- [RLOW.1.4] **Compile-time validation is strict.** Every referenceable name must resolve; every form must be
  dialect-enabled; every typed slot access must match the declared slot
  type. Nothing defers to runtime discovery — the service set is fixed
  at compile time from the imported libraries ([RARC.9.3.4]), so a name
  that does not resolve during lowering does not resolve later either.
